package.description: Fast DEX to Java decompiler in Rust with progressive query subcommands.

en-US.description: Fast DEX to Java decompiler in Rust with progressive query subcommands.
en-US.longDescription: ddc decompiles Android DEX bytecode back into readable Java. It covers DEX 035-041 including multi-dex APKs and XAPK/APKS/APKM containers, and ships more than 20 query subcommands (strings, cross-references, hierarchies, manifest, resources, per-method decompiles) that answer in milliseconds without a full run. Output is jadx-style readable, reproducible Java whose emitted files compile cleanly, and the bilingual CLI localizes its messages between English and Chinese automatically.
en-US.name: ddc

zh-CN.description: 快速的 DEX → Java 反编译器，支持毫秒级渐进式查询子命令。
zh-CN.longDescription: ddc 把 Android DEX 字节码反编译回可读的 Java：覆盖 DEX 035–041 全版本，支持多 dex APK 与 XAPK/APKS/APKM 容器；20 多个查询子命令（字符串、交叉引用、继承谱、manifest、资源、方法粒度反编译）毫秒级出结果，绝大多数分析无需全量反编译。输出为 jadx 风格的可读、可复现 Java，基准 APK 的上百万输出文件全部通过 javac 零语法错误；CLI 会按环境变量在中英文之间自动切换。
